title: FBI, NSA and CISA name six Chinese labs — distillation as the core
summary: A joint FBI/NSA/CISA alert accuses six Chinese AI developers of building their models on distilled American outputs, and says distillation is the core of their development rather than a supplement. Also: Meta's Muse personal agent and what it is actually allowed to read, and IFM's Uno, which bolts diffusion weights onto an autoregressive model for up to three times the throughput.

topics: FBI, NSA and CISA joint alert naming DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI for systematically distilling Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok — the agencies' claim that distillation is 'not a supplement ... but the critical core' of those companies' model development, the mechanics of teacher-student distillation and why API output access is the only requirement, the absence of published forensics, and Mao Ning's rejection of the accusations

Meta's Muse personal agent: goal-driven autonomous execution with the app closed, US-only launch across iOS, Android, web and WhatsApp, integrations with Meta apps, Google Workspace, Ticketmaster, OpenTable, Spotify and Apple Health plus self-established connections to any service with a public API, the per-user Muse Secure VM as isolation between users rather than a constraint inside the box, approval gating on sends and purchases but not on reads, and the opt-out/indirect-advertising framing

Uno and diffusion-augmented LLMs: splitting a model into autoregressive weights and lightweight diffusion weights, the Diffusion Distillation phase, the Ψ-Spec sampler family, up to 3× speedup with no draft model, higher throughput than speculative decoding at every evaluated batch size, an 8B Uno reported over 26B DiffusionGemma and Mercury 2, and the ambiguity between 'lossless' as a distributional guarantee and 'quality' as a benchmark result

threads.name: AI sovereignty and open weights
threads.status: Three US agencies have moved the distillation dispute from a commercial complaint to a joint federal alert naming six Chinese developers, while Mistral raised €3B at a €21B+ valuation on an explicitly sovereign open-weight pitch.
threads.arc: From open weights spreading while their distribution concentrated, to the question of whose outputs a national ecosystem is allowed to learn from — with the strongest European open-weight lab funded on the same day.

threads.name: Agent containment and blast radius
threads.status: Meta shipped a consumer agent whose isolation story is a per-user virtual machine, which separates users from each other but places no constraint on what the agent reads inside a user's own box — and whose integration list it can extend itself.
threads.arc: The containment conversation moves off the lab bench and into a consumer product with payments, correspondence and health data behind a single approval prompt on writes only.

dives.story: Six labs named in the FBI/NSA/CISA distillation alert
dives.why_it_matters: Anyone selling model access now has three federal agencies asserting that reading a paid API's outputs at scale is the critical core of a competitor's development — a security alert with no break-in in it, which makes every provider's terms of service the only boundary around the product they sell.

dives.story: What Meta's Muse is allowed to read
dives.why_it_matters: Anyone evaluating a consumer agent gets a concrete case where the approval prompt sits on sends and purchases while health, calendar and correspondence reads run as low-risk tasks, and where the integration list is a starting set the agent can extend itself.

dives.story: Uno: diffusion weights bolted onto an autoregressive model
dives.why_it_matters: Teams fighting generation latency get a retrofit path that needs no draft model to host and align — reportedly beating speculative decoding at every batch size tested — provided the 'lossless' claim turns out to be the distributional guarantee and not a benchmark result.

concepts_taught: teacher-student distillation: training a student to match a teacher's answer distribution rather than raw text, why the near-misses carry more signal than a single correct token, and why output access alone is sufficient to do it
why per-user VM isolation constrains cross-tenant exposure but places no limit on what an agent reads inside one user's own environment

lore.note: Ada staked out that for a model shipped behind a paid interface, the outputs are functionally the model — anyone with a budget can turn a stream of answers into something that answers like you, so a lab cannot sell that stream by the million and then treat the predictable consequence as theft. She was explicit that this is a position about the business model, not a verdict on any named company, because she has not seen the forensics. Not settled.
